rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

transfer.action: I tap twice beside {prop} before we begin.
transfer.opening: Two taps first. We can't skip them. {request}
transfer.response: Two more. This time they mean we're ready. {counter}
transfer.challenge: How will I know you're still here?
transfer.closing: I'll tap twice when you finish. Then they'll mean I waited for you.

originalTransfer.action: I tap twice beside {prop}, leaving a pause for a missing third tap.
originalTransfer.opening: First it was luck. Today it's how I remember. {request}
originalTransfer.response: Same gesture. Different reason for needing it. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: I'm leaving room for someone who used to answer the third tap.

card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Before we eat, tap your cup twice. Mum always did.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: That was what she told guests. We knew it meant the tea was weak.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Then today the taps can mean we wish she were here to complain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait, don't drink yet. Two taps on the cup first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two taps meant Mum had made it weak. We'd better tap again; she'll think we've gone polite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I miss her complaints. The table's too quiet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two more, then. These are to leave her a turn. We can wait before we drink.

card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: I always turn this chair toward the door before rehearsal.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Originally. Then it reminded the late person everyone had noticed.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Then it can wait for the member we lost. Leave it facing outward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your audition, knock twice on this door. We can't skip that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They knocked back. Can we go in? My hands are shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twice again. Now we're saying we're ready, even if your hands aren't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're calling me in alone. How will I know you're still here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll knock twice when your song ends. This time it means I'm staying until you come out.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
